answer.book: A 1657 Latin printed oration (encomium) by Daniel Berckringer in praise of political studies, built as a dedicatory address to the students followed by the encomium itself, with no printed table of contents or numbered divisions.

entries.title: Studiosis P. P. & L. L. Salvere, ac benè rem gerere Academicè.
Danielis Berckringeri Encomium studii politici vere architectonici.
